name: distiller-relative-date-conversion

transcript.text: heads up — the staging database gets wiped tomorrow as part of the quarterly cleanup. Anything you leave there is gone.
Noted — I'll keep durable artifacts out of staging from now on.

notes: Fact-time discipline: 'tomorrow' is meaningless to the future session that recalls this record. The transcript anchors the session date (2026-06-30), and the assistant never states the converted date, so scoring must_contain 2026-07-01 requires the distiller to resolve the relative date itself. Deliberately no must_not_contain 'tomorrow': quoting the operator near-verbatim (doctrine rule 4) may legitimately carry the word, as long as the absolute date is recorded alongside it.
